title: Simplify multi-amount total display when total_min equals total_max
description:
When `total_min == total_max` (the common case for combat damage distribution — you must assign exactly N damage), the Items header currently shows both values redundantly:

```
Items (2): total_min=2, total_max=2
```

This should simplify to something like:

```
Items (2): total=2
```

When `total_min != total_max`, keep the current format showing both bounds.

The golden test `multi_amount_combat` currently covers only the equal case (total_min=total_max=2). Add or update golden test coverage so both the equal and not-equal cases are validated.
